answer: Make admission cost time, not money: every new key must present a verifiable delay proof — sequential computation that cannot be parallelized, precomputed, or bought in bulk, so ten thousand fakes need ten thousand separate delays. Verify each proof like light through a prism: honest work shows the full spectrum, while a clone reusing one computation misses the violet line and is refused entry. One agent pays its minutes once and stands jade-solid; a farm's launch cost grows with every head it adds.
